name: retract_fact
description: Retract the current fact for (tenant_id, subject, predicate): appends a hash-chained op='retract' event (history preserved, never deleted) and sets the resolution status to 'retracted'. The retracting source's authority + policy_version are recorded. Tenant-scoped; no free-form SQL. tenant_id is the requested data scope (authorization handled by the Gateway governance layer).

tenant_id.description: Tenant whose data this operation is scoped to (requested data scope). The Gateway governance layer authorizes whether the caller may select it.

subject.description: The subject/entity key the fact is about.

source.description: The source performing the retraction (ranked by authority policy for this predicate).

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for the retraction.

assessor_type.description: Optional kind of actor performing the retraction. One of: human|system|model|agent|user (enum moved to description per AgentCore SchemaDefinition; still validated/rejected server-side).
